list.value: gr_id, gr_no and organization_id are required.

script.code:
SELECT CAST(m.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       m.transaction_type,
       m.movement,
       m.trx_no,
       m.parent_trx_no,
       CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(m.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       CAST(m.bin_location_id AS CHAR) AS bin_location_id,
       CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR) AS batch_number_id,
       CAST(m.handling_unit_id AS CHAR) AS handling_unit_id,
       m.inventory_category,
       m.quantity,
       m.base_qty,
       CAST(m.uom_id AS CHAR) AS uom_id,
       CAST(m.base_uom_id AS CHAR) AS base_uom_id,
       m.unit_price,
       m.costing_method_id
FROM inventory_movement m
WHERE m.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvParams.data.grIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND m.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvParams.data.orgSql}}'
  AND (m.trx_no = '{{node:code_node_grRvParams.data.grNoSql}}'
       OR COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = '{{node:code_node_grRvParams.data.grNoSql}}')
  AND m.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY m.id

data.title: Get Later Movements On This Stock
data.nodeName: Get Later Movements On This Stock
data.name: Get Later Movements On This Stock

script.code:
SELECT CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       CAST(MAX(m.id) AS CHAR) AS max_id,
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(
           GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.transaction_type, ' ', COALESCE(m.trx_no, ''))
                        ORDER BY m.id DESC SEPARATOR '|'), '|', 1) AS latest
FROM inventory_movement m
WHERE m.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.minLiveIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND m.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND m.plant_id = CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.plantIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND m.item_id IN ({{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND NOT (m.transaction_type IN ('GRN', 'GRN-R') AND m.trx_no = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.grNoSql}}')
  AND NOT (m.transaction_type IN ('HU', 'HU-R') AND COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.grNoSql}}')
  AND m.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY m.item_id, m.batch_number_id

data.title: Get FIFO Layers From This Receipt
data.nodeName: Get FIFO Layers From This Receipt
data.name: Get FIFO Layers From This Receipt

script.code:
SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(f.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       f.fifo_cost_price,
       f.fifo_initial_quantity,
       f.fifo_available_quantity,
       f.fifo_sequence
FROM fifo_costing_history f
WHERE f.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.grIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND f.plant_id = CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.plantIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND f.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(w.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(w.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(w.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       w.wa_quantity,
       w.wa_cost_price
FROM wa_costing_method w
WHERE w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.plantIdSql}}'
  AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND w.is_deleted = 0
  AND (w.batch_id IS NULL OR w.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.grIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED))

SELECT 'FIFO' AS t, CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM fifo_costing_history f
WHERE f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND f.plant_id = CAST('{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.plantIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND f.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY f.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WA' AS t, CAST(w.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM wa_costing_method w
WHERE w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.plantIdSql}}'
  AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_grRvPrep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND w.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY w.material_id
